idea-plugin.name: Shared DataSources
idea-plugin.description:
Share one set of JetBrains Database data sources across all your projects.

This plugin replaces the project-level .idea/dataSources.xml and .idea/dataSources.local.xml files with symbolic links pointing at a single shared copy — create a data source once, every project picks it up.

Features

  • Automatic sync on project open — runs as a post-startup activity, no manual steps.
  • Symlink-based — the shared files are the single source of truth; edits made in any project are visible everywhere.
  • Safe by default — existing regular files are backed up before being replaced.
  • Idempotent — correct symlinks are skipped; wrong ones are re-created.
  • Notifications — success and failure are reported via IDE balloon notifications.
  • Configurable — shared directory, auto-sync, and auto-backup can be toggled in settings.

How It Works

On every project open (when enabled), the plugin:

  1. Reads the shared directory from settings (must exist and contain dataSources.xml / dataSources.local.xml).
  2. Checks the project's .idea directory (skips projects without one).
  3. For each data source file:
    • Correct symlink → skipped
    • Wrong symlink → removed and re-created
    • Regular file → backed up (optional), then replaced with a symlink
    • Missing → fresh symlink created
  4. Backups are written to .idea/dataSources_backup_auto/ (only if no backup for that file exists yet).
  5. Shows a notification listing how many files were linked, or any errors encountered.

Requirements

  • Any JetBrains IDE based on IntelliJ Platform 2024.1 (241) through 2025.2 (252.*) with the Database plugin (com.intellij.database) — e.g. GoLand, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. (Built and tested against GoLand 2024.1.4.)
  • Symlink support on Windows: creating symlinks requires either an elevated shell or Windows Developer Mode enabled.

Installation

Build the ZIP from source (gradlew buildPlugin or make plugin), then install it via Settings/Preferences → Plugins → Install Plugin from Disk… and restart the IDE.

Configuration

Settings/Preferences → Tools → Shared DataSources

  • Shared directory (default: ${java.io.tmpdir}/.shared-datasources, e.g. C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Temp\.shared-datasources on Windows, /tmp/.shared-datasources on Linux) — directory containing the shared dataSources.xml and dataSources.local.xml.
  • Enable automatic sync on project open (default: on) — run the sync automatically each time a project is opened.
  • Auto backup existing files before replacing (default: on) — back up existing regular files to .idea/dataSources_backup_auto/ first.

To get started: copy dataSources.xml and dataSources.local.xml from any project's .idea folder into the shared directory, then open any project — the files under .idea will be linked to the shared copies.

Development

make run           # launch a sandbox IDE with the plugin installed
make test          # run tests
make plugin        # build the plugin ZIP into ./out/
make clean         # remove build outputs and ./out
make distclean     # also remove .gradle and .intellijPlatform caches

Equivalent Gradle tasks: runIde, test, buildPlugin, clean.

src/main/kotlin/com/github/shareddatasources/
├── SharedDataSourcesActivity.kt       # Post-startup sync logic (symlink creation, backup)
├── SharedDataSourcesConfigurable.kt   # Settings UI (Settings → Tools → Shared DataSources)
└── SharedDataSourcesSettings.kt       # Persistent application-level settings (sharedDataSources.xml)

src/main/resources/META-INF/
├── plugin.xml                         # Plugin descriptor & extension registrations
├── pluginIcon.svg                     # Plugin logo (light theme)
└── pluginIcon_dark.svg                # Plugin logo (dark theme)

Notes & Limitations

  • The default shared directory lives under the OS temp directory, which the system may clean automatically (e.g. on reboot or by Storage Sense). Once you start relying on the shared data sources, point the setting at a persistent location instead.
  • The sync only runs on project open; changes made to the shared files while a project is already open are picked up by the IDE naturally, since it is the same underlying file.
  • Shared file names are fixed: dataSources.xml and dataSources.local.xml.
  • The plugin never deletes data silently: regular files are backed up first (when auto-backup is on), and backup files are not overwritten if they already exist.

action.description: Remove symlinks and restore original dataSources files from backup. Run this before uninstalling the plugin.
